machines.name: Creality Ender-3 (0.4 mm nozzle)
start_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp} ; set final bed temp
G4 S30 ; allow partial nozzle warmup
M104 S{first_layer_temp} ; set final nozzle temp
M190 S{bed_temp} ; wait for bed temp to stabilize
M109 S{first_layer_temp} ; wait for nozzle temp to stabilize
G1 X2.0 Y140 E10 F1500 ; prime the nozzle
G1 X2.3 Y10 E10 F1200 ; prime the nozzle
end_gcode: M84 X Y E ; disable motors
notes: Creality Ender-3 (0.4 mm nozzle): no print layer height is given; a nozzle-based default is used. Import a complete config to use your slicer's print preset.
